map.地质图件生成工具。按输入的地层参数生成柱状图、剖面等地质图件文本，可直接复制用于: Geological map generation tool. Generates column, section and other geological map text from the entered stratum parameters, ready to copy into reports, for geological logging and data compilation.
map.编录成图：把钻孔或地层编录数据转成可复制的柱状图文本，直接贴入报告: Compiling into a diagram: turn borehole or stratum logging data into copyable column text to paste straight into a report
map.教学示意：快速生成标准分层柱状，辅助野外教学与课件: Teaching illustration: quickly generate a standard layered column to support field teaching and courseware
map.资料整理：批量输出多个钻孔的岩性序列，统一归档格式: Data compilation: batch output lithology sequences for several boreholes in a unified archiving format
map.：用法：按从上到下的顺序录入各地层（岩性、厚度、符号等），工具按层序渲染柱状/剖: : Usage: enter each stratum in order from top to bottom (lithology, thickness, symbol and so on), and the tool renders column/section text by layer order. It is recommended to note lithology, thickness (m) and key markers (such as fossils or mineralization) for each layer; common single-layer thickness is 0.5-5 m with total thickness often 10-30 m, and thickness is unified in m (generated locally, nothing is uploaded).
: Example: enter 5 layers - sandstone 2.0 m, mudstone 3.0 m, limestone 5.0 m, shale 1.0 m, basalt 4.0 m, total thickness 15.0 m; the tool generates top-down column text and marks the cumulative depth at each layer (2/5/10/11/15 m).
map.生成的是图片还是文本？: Does it generate an image or text?
